title: Whole Earth Catalog page 187: 15th-century Scandinavian 'Witch Rider' tale
summary: Brent tells of Whole Earth Catalog page 187: 15th-century Scandinavian 'Witch Rider' tale, about 15th century tale; found a couple of weeks after the encounter at Soap Plant bookstore, Melrose, Los Angeles; Scandinavia, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Soap Plant bookstore, Melrose, Los Angeles; Scandinavia

tellings.quote: And I find this book of outof print uh ghost stories from Scandinavia in the 15th century.

plain: A man named Brent says that a couple of weeks after a strange encounter of his own, he went into the Soap Plant bookstore on Melrose in Los Angeles. He says page 187 of the Whole Earth Catalog, a well-known counterculture guide to books and tools, led him to an out-of-print book of 15th-century Scandinavian ghost stories. In it he found a tale called the "Witch Rider," which he tells as an old echo of what happened to him.
